name: Live cursor
description: A named cursor flies in and drags a selection box over the speaker. The box turns into a design-tool selection with handles, a live size badge and an outline round the body. Then the cursor drags the speaker sideways like a layer, and the speaker slides back.
when: When you talk about an agent or a tool that does the work for you, or about editing yourself: 'it moves me around like a layer'.
needs: the box round the speaker's head and chest
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
a clean plate: the room without the speaker (plate.png)
